entries.061eddb46cf7088a: A group consisting of the company and 22 subsidiaries. A specialist manufacturer whose main business is the manufacture, processing and sale of various products made of engineering plastics and their composite materials; its head office is in Kawaguchi, Saitama Prefecture. Consolidated headcount is 1,371 employees (as of March 31, 2026). Research and development is carried out across all business fields by the company and Enplas Kenkyusho Co., Ltd.; ENPLAS AMERICA, INC. oversees the group's North American region, and ENPLAS（EUROPE）LTD. oversees the group companies in Europe.
entries.1b2182352857f64c: A business that manufactures and sells various IC test sockets and burn-in sockets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,603 million. In Japan, Enplas Handotai Kiki Co., Ltd. and QMS Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products; overseas, ENPLAS SEMICONDUCTOR PERIPHERALS PTE.LTD. and others manufacture and sell them, and ENPLAS TECH SOLUTIONS, INC. and others sell them.
entries.545cb7c4b249512c: A business that manufactures and sells life science-related products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,083 million. These include products for genetic testing and microfluidic devices used to analyze biomolecules, cells and other materials. In Japan, QMS Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells the products; overseas, ENPLAS LIFE TECH, INC. manufactures and sells them, and ENPLAS（U.S.A.）, INC. and ENPLAS（EUROPE）LTD. sell them.
entries.d119488c4371b711: A business that manufactures and sells optical communication devices and diffusion lenses for LEDs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,652 million. Overseas, ENPLAS HI-TECH（SINGAPORE）PTE.LTD., ENPLAS TECH SOLUTIONS, INC. and others sell the products, and ENPLAS（VIETNAM）CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells them.
entries.eab8f6f864280a78: A precision plastic components manufacturer that makes IC test sockets, precision gears and other products from engineering plastics.
